summary: DakMock full-stack test complete. Backend: 17/17 pytest cases passed covering auth (register/login/me/logout/dup), catalog (categories, pricing, free series list, paid access denied), exam flow (get/submit/attempt detail/leaderboard), mock payments + referral reward (userB purchase gives userA +1 token), wallet payout threshold, support ticket, admin (stats/users/tickets/payouts/settings/RBAC 403), pricing update+GET verify, sample-template + bulk .xlsx upload. Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844): register/login/logout works; Home shows greeting + tier chips + free practice list; Tests tab tier filter chips filter list correctly; paid series opens plan modal with Single ₹149 / Combo ₹249; mock Combo purchase completes and unlocks the paid series (Start Test appears); free test exam flow runs (timer counting down, EN/HI language toggle switches question text to Hindi, option select, Mark for Review, Save & Next, palette bottom sheet with color-coded statuses + jump-to-Q works, Submit → confirm → Results); Results screen shows Score/Percentile/Rank/#3 of 3 and Analysis/Ranks/Solutions segmented control renders (Solutions shows explanations with Correct/Skipped badges); Wallet shows token balance, referral code + copy/share, referrals list, and claim-payout disabled under threshold; Profile shows Active Subscriptions, links to Admin Panel (admin only), Support, Logout; Admin Panel loads with 5 modules (Users, Bulk Upload, Pricing & Gateway, Payouts, Tickets). Two minor React Native Web deprecation warnings observed (pointerEvents prop, shadow* style props).

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Search components using pointerEvents prop and move it into style prop.
Console warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Replace shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius with boxShadow in StyleSheet.

action_items: Address RN Web deprecation warnings: move pointerEvents to style, and replace shadow* props with boxShadow (cosmetic; does not affect functionality).
Optional: add testID for the results screen segmented tabs (Analysis/Ranks/Solutions) and 'See all exam passes' interior CTA to make future automation simpler.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~1030 lines and mixes auth, catalog, payments, referrals, admin, seeding, and bulk-upload. Consider splitting into modules (auth.py, catalog.py, payments.py, admin.py, seed.py) once feature-stable.
seed() runs on every startup and is idempotent via count checks, which is fine. Admin seed hardcodes password 'Admin@123' — acceptable for demo; document clearly.
/api/admin/payout-requests/{id}/action takes action as a query param — works but consider making it a JSON body for consistency with other admin PUT/POST endpoints.
Payment verify uses HMAC-SHA256 correctly for real Razorpay mode; mock mode short-circuits signature check as designed.
seed_data_creation: No manual seed data created; server auto-seeds categories, test series, tests, and admin user on startup. Test users prefixed with TEST_ or test_ created during tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py and cover full happy path incl. mock payments + referral reward. EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env is used. Admin creds: admin@dakmock.com / Admin@123. Payments run in MOCK mode: POST /api/payments/orders returns {mock:true, local_order_id}; POST /api/payments/verify with just local_order_id activates a 1-year subscription. Frontend testIDs for all critical elements: tab-signup/tab-login/input-email/password/name/referral/submit-auth, filter-{category_id}, series-card-{id}, buy-single/buy-combo/close-plan-modal, start-test-{id}, exam-timer, lang-en/lang-hi, option-{i}, mark-review/clear-ans/save-next, open-palette, palette-q-{i}, submit-exam/cancel-submit/confirm-submit, referral-code/copy-code/share-code/open-claim, nav-admin/nav-support/nav-wallet/logout-btn, ticket-subject/message/submit-ticket, price-single/price-combo/save-pricing, pick-upload/download-template.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no functional issues found. Initial test failure on register was a test-side bug (server lowercases stored email); fixed by using lowercase test email in the test.
